sam_corp: Hey team — we're seeing JSON mode failures from the hosted API when creating orders. The schema expects order.total as a number but the response has it as a quoted string, and status enum casing is mixed. Breaking our downstream validator. Can someone take a look?

jess: Thanks Sam. Can you paste the curl you used and the JSON schema you're validating against? Also which model and whether you're using strict json mode?

sam_corp: curl we used: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-***' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-2","input":"generate order json","json_schema":{...},"json_mode":"strict"}'``` Schema snippet: ```{"type":"object","properties":{"order":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"total":{"type":"number"},"status":{"type":"string","enum":["PENDING","COMPLETE","FAILED"]}},"required":["id","total","status"]}}}``` We saw the error at production when our validator failed on order.total.

jess: Got it. Any sample raw model output (the text before the platform tried to coerce/parse)? We need the exact bytes to repro. Also which region and timestamp of the failing request?

sam_corp: Here's the raw text returned by the model from the failing request: ```{"order":{"id":"ord_12345","total":"1234.50","status":"Pending","notes":null}}``` Note total is quoted, status is "Pending" (case mismatch), and notes is null — we expected notes to be omitted or string. Request id r-0fd7c9 at 1955554320 in us-west-2.

ali: Reproduced locally with the same model + strict json mode. The platform parser rejects because number != string and enum case mismatch. Error from parse: `TypeError: $.order.total expected number but got string` and `ValueError: $.order.status not in enum`.

ali: Quick root cause: a change in the JSON extractor that we rolled out yesterday preserves explicit quotes the model emits (we intended to avoid accidental coercion). For strict mode that means quoted numbers stay strings. It also doesn't do case-normalization for enums.

jess: OK, short-term mitigation: if you can, switch json_mode to "permissive" or set a client-side coercion step. Example permissive curl: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-***' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-2","input":"generate order json","json_mode":"permissive"}'``` That will accept quoted numbers and attempt coercion.

sam_corp: Permissive works as a workaround, but we rely on strict mode for safety. Can you fix strict so numeric strings get coerced when schema expects number? And enum casing — we need deterministic behavior.

ali: Agree. Plan: roll a small patch to the extractor to attempt safe coercion for numeric-looking strings when schema type==number in strict mode, and add an option to perform case-insensitive enum matching (default off). We'll gate it behind a feature flag so we can roll back quickly. I'll create INF-4821.

maya_oncall: Tagging infra:deploy — I'll schedule a quick canary to us-west-2 only so we can verify no regressions. ETA ~2 hours.

deploy-bot: deploy started by maya_oncall: canary/extractor-coerce-numbers -> us-west-2 (1/3 hosts)

jess: For now, Sam, we can issue a one-time credit for the failed requests while this is being fixed. Please open a billing ticket referencing this thread and I'll escalate.

sam_corp: Thanks all — appreciate the quick responses. Keep me posted on the INF ticket and canary result.

ali: Will post logs and the PR here once available. Short-term note: if you need strict guarantees today, consider adjusting schema to accept string|number for total: `{\"anyOf\":[{\"type\":\"number\"},{\"type\":\"string\"}]}` and validate post-parse.

jess: Marking as escalated to engineering (INF-4821). Closing loop once patch verifies in canary. :thumbsup:

sam_corp: Received, thanks :pray:
